out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for changes in equipment/ equipment additions for the following: ice machine, water kettle, deli slicer, steamer under hood, refrigerated sauce station.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: SPECIFICATION SHEETS FOR ALL EQUIPMENT. REDPOT (Inspection Date: 08/14/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing sink located in the kitchen is filled with used to go containers preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EMPLOYEE MOVED CONTAINERS TO DISHWASHER.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: employee picked up fallen food with gloved hand, rinsed glove and returned to task.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INFORMED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: all equipment passed through the dishwasher.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. FACILITY TO SETUP SINK WITH BLEACH AND WATER TO SANITIZE EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: walk in cooler- pig ear 45°F, pig feet 46°F, pork belly 46°F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. WIC OPEN DURING PREP 30MIN-1HR. EHS INFORMED CFM TO LOWER THERMOSTAT AND ALSO SUGGEST HAVE UNIT SERVICED. CFM TO MONITOR TEMPERATURES.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: several foods in the walk in cooler to include pork ear, feet, and pork belly. And foods in the refrigerated merchandiser was also not observed date marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: all spices on spice cart in front of wok station.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The chemical dishwasher is not operating properly.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap was not observed at the plumbing of the sanitizing compartment sink. Sink closest to WIF.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the filters in the hoods already has a build up of grease deposits.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
